name: Deutsche Welle
body: frame-ancestors 'none' stops other sites from framing it, HSTS is on, and every page analyzed has a canonical. But X-Content-Type-Options is missing on all 20 pages analyzed, so browsers may guess file types.
lesson: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response. One header stops browsers running a file as the wrong type.
summary: www.dw.com scores 82 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 19 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 6 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 6 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search) by Disallow: /, ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /, Perplexity-User (Perplexity, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /,…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 9 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /en/latest-audio/s-62391692, /en/latin-america/s-58267484, /en/north-america/s-58267502, /en/climate/s-59752983 and 5 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
